## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `024092b03355d856ede501bb55d6dcbda875b900`
Local-runs: probe — `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the committed file list, to read the face (NOT GOVERNED, 19 paths)

Face: the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone (no published schema, no governed path), so the lane seat reviews at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Inputs read: the card objectui#13384, its claim 6368680261 and the seat's amendment widening the file surface, and the PR diff at this head. Check conclusions are taken from this head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff widens three public types of `@object-ui/core` and changes no existing member:

1. **`ActionRunnerHandler`** is now the same function type intersected with an optional `refuseBeforeInput(action, context)`. Every existing handler is still assignable.
   - The runner asks it only on the handler it will dispatch to, after the condition and disabled gates and before the confirmation and the param dialog.
   - An answer becomes a refused `ActionResult` through the usual post-execution path (toast, `onFailure`). `undefined` lets the run go on exactly as before.
   - An update-operation action never reaches a registered handler, so it is never asked.
   - Correct.
2. **`ServerActionHandler`** gains the same optional member. `createServerActionHandler` sets it from the very resolver the dispatch runs, including a host's own `resolveRecordId`.
   - A record page, whose context carries the record id, is therefore never refused early.
   - A dialog that itself collects `recordId` is not judged before it runs.
   - The dispatch keeps its own check for callers that invoke the handler directly.
   - Correct.
3. **`ServerActionRecordIdResolution`** gains an optional `errorKey`. `error` keeps the exact English text it carried before, so a host that shows `error` sees no change.
   - The runner translates the early refusal by that key through the translator it already has (`setTranslator`).
   - Core gains no i18n dependency.
   - Correct.

The rule is asked of the handler rather than held in the runner. That is the right altitude: a related-list grid publishes `selectedRecords: []` into a record page's runner, so a row rule in the runner would refuse every `record_header` action there.

The console wrapper `createConsoleServerActionHandler` forwards the member. Without the forward the console behaviour would not change; the dev measured both with and without it. The 12331 suite's five 0-row and 2-row cases now assert no dialog, the refusal toast and no request. The other claims in that suite are unchanged.

### ② Semver level

The changeset declares `patch` for `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, and no `major`.
- The new members are optional and inert when absent.
- This lane accepted the same level for an optional exported member on PR #13373 (objectui#13331).
- Accepted as `patch`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The file surface was widened by the seat's claim amendment to cover `consoleServerAction.ts` and the 12331 test. Both are in this diff, and nothing outside the amended surface is touched.
- `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` belongs to objectui#13379 (PR #13394) and is untouched.
  - Its `flowHandler` still calls `resolveServerActionRecordId` directly, so a flow action with params launched from a list toolbar still opens its dialog first, with an English refusal.
  - The wrapper's `newTabUrl` refusal is still English.
  - Both are named in the PR's Acceptance notes as follow-ups. Neither moves a floor: no security or permission boundary, no published contract semantics, no capability trade-off, no gate strength.
- No open questions from the dev.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-13384-record-action-row-guard`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj`

**VERDICT: PASS**

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `a297aa733624925adc7077d7413ed8c7f6efca81`
Local-runs: probe — `git diff 024092b03..a297aa733 --stat` (one test file, +18/−2)

Face: the same `Clause-②: yes` declaration as the record at `024092b03` (comment 6369313613). Since then the head has moved by one test-only commit, so this record carries that review forward to the new head.

### ① Derived judgments

`a297aa733` changes only `ObjectView.bulkWiredHeaderDuplicate-12462.test.tsx`. CI at `024092b03` had failed on its control case, "the same link arms: the param dialog opens", which runs `?runAction=create_campaign`: a record-scoped action launched with no row selected. That is exactly the 0-row launch this PR now refuses before any dialog. The dev measured it: with the console forward removed, the file passes 6/6.

The deep link supplies no record id in any form the resolver misses, so the new behaviour is right and the pin's premise changed. The case keeps its claim, that the link arms and is consumed on a view that does not wire it. It now shows the run by the refusal toast and the absence of a dialog. Its "not armed" twin now also asserts that no refusal toast appears.

The judgments of the earlier record (the three widened types, the forward, the record-page exemption) are unchanged, because no source file moved.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `patch` for `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, no `major`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev reran all of `packages/app-shell/src/views/` (1134 files, 10817 passed) and every app-shell test that reads `consoleServerAction` or `resolveServerActionRecordId` (11 files, 204 passed). No other test assumed a dialog opens for a record-scoped action with 0 rows.
- The PR body's Tests section reports `024092b03` and does not mention this update; this record carries it.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-13384-record-action-row-guard`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj`
